errors.text_span: 展示了不同实体中“一项调查”的文章分布情况
errors.evidence: The chart purpose is incorrectly described as showing 'article distribution of a survey in different entities,' whereas the figure actually represents 'word frequency and distribution of variable words in different registers.'
The description states the y-axis range is 0 to 8000, but the figure shows a range of 0 to 7000.
The description claims the tallest bar in chart (a) is close to 8000, but the actual value is approximately 6700.
The description states that one bar in chart (b) exceeds 6000, but the actual value is approximately 4200.
The description interprets the y-axis as representing 'article quantity,' but it actually represents 'word frequency.'
The machine-generated description does not mention that the charts represent 'word frequency and distribution of variable words in different registers.'
The description does not mention the x-axis labels, which represent different registers ('新闻,' '学术,' '网络小说,' '微博').
The description does not mention the segmented structure of the bars, where different colors represent different variable word categories as indicated in the legend.
The description does not mention that chart (a) has the tallest bar in the '新闻' category and the shortest in the '学术' category.
The description does not mention that chart (b) has the tallest bar in the '网络小说' category and the shortest in the '微博' category.
